scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
eeeeei~ ha!
The weather is really great.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
嘿嘿~
天氣真好啊。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Wow, you've come back so quickly.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
哇，你回來得真快。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Before you change into a Ranger, I'll need to evaluate your pure abilities.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
在你轉職為遊俠之前，我需要評估一下你的基礎能力。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Um. That you talked to me again means that you are determined to change into a Ranger and take the survival power test.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
嗯。既然你又來找我了，看來你是下定決心要轉職為遊俠，並接受生存能力測試了。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
I knew it.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
我就知道。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Umm?
What are you waiting for?
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
嗯？
你在等什麼？

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Are you still wandering about here?
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
你還在這裡遊蕩嗎？

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Oh, hey. What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
哦，嘿。你在這裡做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Oh, hey. Who's this?
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
哦，嘿。這位是誰？

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Ho. Who's this~
You really look talented...
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
喲。這位是~
看起來很有天賦呢...

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Ha ~ ha.
The weather is really great.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
哈~哈。
天氣真好啊。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
What's up?
The monsters here are a
little tough so be careful.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
怎麼了？
這裡的魔物有點強，小心點。

scripts.text: I came here to become to a Ranger.
scripts.translation: 我想轉職為遊俠。

scripts.text: I just came to look around.
scripts.translation: 我只是隨便逛逛。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Oh ya?
The weather is really great. Shall we take a picture to commemorate it?
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
哦？
天氣真好啊。要不要拍張照留念一下？

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
No?
Then just look around quietly and then go back.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
不？
那就安靜地看看，然後回去吧。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Huh?
How did you find me?
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
咦？
你怎麼找到我的？

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Well, it's a passing mark that you recognize me... let me see.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
嗯，能認出我算是個小小的成就吧...讓我看看。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
No.
I can tell just by looking at you that you seem to be inexperienced.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
不。
光看你的樣子，我就知道你很缺乏經驗。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Have more pride in your job and get more experience, and then when you grow as a Hunter or a Sniper you can make an aura by yourself, please come back again.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
對自己的職業多一點自豪感，多積累一些經驗。等你成長為獵人或神射手，能夠自己製造靈氣時，請再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Ok!
It looks like you have
enough experience.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
好！
看來你的經驗值已經足夠了。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Good.
First of all, let me tell you the job change qualifications to be a Ranger.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
很好。
首先，讓我告訴你成為遊俠的職業轉職資格。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
I've already checked the first qualification that you've experienced enough to make an aura as a Hunter or a Sniper.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
我已經確認過第一項資格，即你作為獵人或神射手擁有足夠的經驗值來製造靈氣。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
For the second qualification to judge one's ability exactly, you need to lighten your body and mind.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
為了準確判斷你的能力，你需要減輕身體和心靈的負擔。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Ah wait, before that.
When you change a job into a Ranger from a Hunter,
you won't get any chance to learn the skills of a Sniper, would that be okay?
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
啊，等等，在那之前。
當你從獵人轉職為遊俠時，你將沒有機會學習神射手的技能，這樣可以嗎？

scripts.text: I'll think about it more.
scripts.translation: 我再考慮一下。

scripts.text: I want to be a Ranger already.
scripts.translation: 我想立刻成為遊俠。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Okay.
Take your time to think, if it's okay then come back.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
好的。
請慢慢考慮，如果決定好了，請回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
All right.
You are ready then.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
很好。
看來你已經準備好了。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Well let's continue our conversation.
Before you change into a Ranger, even though you reached the highest level of a Hunter, it is not the best evaluation of your abilities.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
那麼，讓我們繼續剛才的話題。
在你轉職為遊俠之前，即使你達到了獵人的最高等級，這也不是對你能力最好的評價。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
So in order to check your abilities, I'll need to evaluate your pure abilities.~
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
所以，為了檢查你的能力，我需要評估你的純粹能力。~

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Before you change into a Ranger, even though you reached the highest level of a Sniper, it is not the best evaluation of your abilities.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
在你轉職為遊俠之前，即使你達到了神射手的最高等級，這也不是對你能力最好的評價。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor]
So in order to check your abilities, I'll need to evaluate your pure abilities.~
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員]
所以，為了檢查你的能力，我需要評估你的純粹能力。~

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
To do this you need to be cleansed of body and soul.
Make sure that your weight equals '0' to continue.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
要做到這一點，你需要淨化身心。
請確保你的負重為“0”以繼續。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Ok, now I'll talk about the requirements to take the test to become a Ranger.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
好的，現在我來談談參加遊俠測試的要求。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
All the tests to become a Ranger are going to be done with practical means.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
所有成為遊俠的測試都將以實踐方式進行。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Will there be a written test?
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
會有筆試嗎？

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Why do you want one?
The most important part of this test is the test of your experience on the battlefield.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
你為什麼想要筆試？
這次測試最重要的是對你戰場經驗的測試。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Therefore, what I request of you is to prove your power of survival.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
因此，我要求你證明你的生存能力。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
I want to see the real power of survival, even if you fall down and get beat up.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
我想看到真正的生存能力，即使你跌倒並被打倒。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
If you succeed with this survival power test, you will receive the first qualification.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
如果你通過了這次生存能力測試，你將獲得第一階段的資格。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Well, let's talk about the details when you get the qualification for taking the test.
When you want to take the survival power test, please talk to me again.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
等你獲得了參加測試的資格，我們再詳細討論。
當你準備好參加生存能力測試時，請再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
To do this you need to be cleansed of body and soul.
Make sure that your weight equals 0 to continue.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
要做到這一點，你需要淨化身心。
請確保你的負重為0，以便繼續。

scripts.text: I'll think about it more
scripts.translation: 我再考慮一下

scripts.text: I'll take the test
scripts.translation: 我要參加測試

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Prepare yourself very well before taking this test.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
在參加這次測試之前，請做好充分準備。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Think about it well and come back.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
好好考慮一下，然後再回來。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
If you are determined, then there's nothing to wait for.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
如果你已經下定決心，那就沒什麼好猶豫的了。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
I'll explain it simply.
What I'm going to provide you is 10 Fly Wings, 500 of Arrows and 1 test Bow.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
我簡單說明一下。
我會提供給你10個蒼蠅翅膀、500支箭和1把測試用弓。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Take the provided items and all you have to do for the survival power test is ^0000ffgo to the Northwestern area of Turtle Island and find Instructor Teardrop^000000.
Easy, right?
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
帶上提供的物品，你只需要^0000ff前往海龜島的西北區域，找到指導員淚滴^000000。
很簡單，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Remember that you don't have any other equipment on, so be careful of the monsters.
Ready to start?
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
記住，你沒有其他裝備，所以要小心魔物。
準備好開始了嗎？

scripts.text: Wait a second
scripts.translation: 等一下

scripts.text: Yes, I'm ready
scripts.translation: 是的，我準備好了

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
What kind of preparation can be so long.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
什麼樣的準備需要這麼久。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Come again when you are absolutely ready.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
等你完全準備好後再來。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Well, then let's start.
There's no time to hesitate.
Do your best.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
那麼，我們開始吧。
沒有時間猶豫了。
盡力而為。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Why did you bring so much?
It's good that you do your best on the job change but, the key to this test is to test our true abilities...
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
你為什麼帶了這麼多東西？
雖然換職業時盡力而為是好事，但這次測試的關鍵是檢驗我們的真實能力...

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
If you don't make your weight 0, you wouldn't be able to take the test.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
如果你的負重不為0，你就無法參加測試。

scripts.text: Tell me the mission again.
scripts.translation: 再告訴我一次任務內容。

scripts.text: I just wanted to talk.
scripts.translation: 我只是想聊聊。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Oh, ya.
Is this the mind of a person who's going to take the test?
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
哦，是嗎。
這就是準備參加測試的人的心態嗎？

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Stay alert and listen.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
保持警惕，仔細聽好。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Take the provided items and all you have to do for the survival power test is ^0000ffgo to the Northwestern area of Turtle Island and find Instructor Teardrop^000000.
Isn't that so easy?
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
帶上提供的物品，生存能力測試只需要^0000ff前往海龜島的西北區域，找到考試指導員 淚滴^000000。
很簡單吧？

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
As you don't have any equipment on, be careful of the monsters in the field.
Well, shall we start?
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
既然你沒有裝備，就要小心野外出現的魔物。
那麼，我們要開始了嗎？

scripts.text: Wait a minute
scripts.translation: 等一下

scripts.text: I will start
scripts.translation: 我要開始

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
What kind of preparation can be so long.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
什麼樣的準備需要這麼久。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Come again when you are absolutely ready.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
等你完全準備好後再來。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Okay, let's start.
There's no time to hesitate, so do your best.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
好的，我們開始吧。
沒有時間猶豫了，盡力而為。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
I don't think you have the time for that.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
我覺得你沒時間做這種事。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Hurry up and finish the test.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
快點完成測試。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Well, if you are an easy person, that's none of my business but if you decided once, wouldn't it be better to take the practical test in a minute and meet me after becoming a Ranger?
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
好吧，如果你是個隨性的人，那我也管不著。但既然你已經決定了，不如馬上參加實戰測試，變成遊俠後再來見我，這樣不是更好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Because you've disappeared suddenly, the Ranger Master was looking for you.
Do you want to go to him now?
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
因為你突然消失了，遊俠的師父一直在找你。
你想現在去找他嗎？

scripts.text: Don't go
scripts.translation: 不去

scripts.text: Go
scripts.translation: 去

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Are you busy with something else?
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
你在忙別的事情嗎？

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Then I'll send you, please be well.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
那我就送你去，請保重。

scripts.text: Oh, hey. Who's this?
scripts.translation: 哦，嘿。這是誰？

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Hey, you look great.
Congratulations on becoming a Ranger~
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
嘿，你看起來很棒。
恭喜你成為遊俠~

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Next time, try not to intimidate other people.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
下次，試著不要抄襲別人。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
Next time, try not to intimidate other people.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
下次，試著不要抄襲別人。

scripts.text:
[Survival Instructor, Rescue]
What's up?
The monsters here are a
little tough so be careful.
scripts.translation:
[生存指導員 救援]
怎麼了？
這裡的魔物有點強，小心點。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Good to goooooo!!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
好耶~~~~~!!!!!!

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Oh! Oh! Woooooow!
You've brought it! Let me see...
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
哦！哦！哇哦！
你帶來了！讓我看看...

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
What are you doing there? Standing with a blank look.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
你在那兒幹什麼？
一臉呆滯地站著。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Awooo. Yumyum.
Eh? What are you looking at?
You want to eat some?
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
阿嗚。真好吃。
咦？你在看什麼？
想吃一點嗎？

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Oh, hey. What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
哦，你好。
你在這裡做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Wow. Who's this?
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
哇。這是誰？

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Good to gooooooooooooooo!!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
好耶~~~~~!!!!!!

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Huh? Who are you? What are you doing here, you baby archer.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
咦？你是誰？
你在這裡做什麼，小弓箭手。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
May I tell you one thing?
If you want to change a job to a Ranger, first talk to Survival Instructor Rescue.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
我可以告訴你一件事嗎？
如果你想轉職成遊俠，
先去和生存指導員 救援談談。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Then he will tell you the requirement for the job change test!!!
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
然後他會告訴你轉職考試的要求！！！

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Huh? Who are you? What are you doing here, you baby archer.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
咦？你是誰？
你在這裡做什麼，小弓箭手。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
That you are coming and going bugs me so, would you please stop?!
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
你這樣來來回回地跑讓我很困擾，
請不要再這樣了好嗎？！

scripts.text: Ranger practical test building?
scripts.translation: 遊俠實戰考試建築？

scripts.text: I came for the test.
scripts.translation: 我來參加考試的。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
What, what are you...?
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
你，你在幹什麼...？

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
What do you think you are looking at?
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
你在看什麼？

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
How could you be a Ranger if you can't even recognize what's in front of you? Get out of here!
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
連眼前的東西都認不出來，
怎麼當遊俠？
給我滾出去！

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Ho, having come this far, it means you've passed the first survival test.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
哼，既然你能走到這裡，
說明你通過了第一關生存測試。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
But, can you be sure that there wasn't any cheating?
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
但是，你能確定沒有作弊嗎？

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
See, I knew it.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
看吧，我就知道。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Having done the test normally, you would have adjusted your weight to 0, and hold the items provided by Rescue!
But, how come you weigh so much?
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
正常完成測試的話，
你應該把負重調整為0，
並持有救援提供的物品！
但是，為什麼你的負重這麼高？

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
I consider this as cheating!
Come and see me again!
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
我視此為作弊！
再來找我一次！

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Hmm. It's doubtful...
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
嗯。這很可疑...

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
I don't smell any signs of cheating. For now...
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
我沒有聞到任何作弊的跡象。暫時...

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Before taking a practical test, I want to eat something.
You know the food situation isn't always so good in a foreign land.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
在進行實操測試之前，我想吃點東西。
你知道，在異國他鄉，食物狀況並不總是那麼好的。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
I know that the very basic way to survive might be raising the strength of one's own body. But, I find that sending adventurers is easier for me.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
我知道生存的最基本方式可能是增強自身的力量。但對我來說，派遣冒險者似乎更容易。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
So, kill ^0000ff1 Dragon Tail^000000 and bring me ^0000ff1 Wing of Dragonfly^000000.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
所以，去殺^0000ff1刺尾蜻蜓^000000，並給我帶^0000ff1蜻蜓的翅膀^000000來。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
If you run out of the provided items, we cannot support you more so take care.
Consider this as an extension of the survival power test.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
如果你提供的物品用完了，我們就無法再支援你了，所以請小心。
把這當作生存能力測試的延伸吧。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Hmmmm, it's still hot?!
You don't seem to be hurt anywhere...
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
嗯...還是這麼熱？！
你看起來哪裡都沒受傷...

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Good, for now you're qualified for the practical test.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
很好，暫時你通過了實操測試的資格。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Well, before I explain, could you please give me that Dragonfly wing?
You've heard the saying, 'in any situation, eating comes first'?
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
嗯，在我解釋之前，能把那個蜻蜓翅膀給我嗎？
你聽過那句“無論什麼情況，吃飯第一”的話吧？

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
I'm hungry.
Before taking the practical test, I want to eat something.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
我餓了。
在進行實操測試之前，我想吃點東西。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
I know that the very basic way to survive might be raising the strength of one's own body. But, I find that sending adventurers is easier for me.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
我知道生存的最基本方式可能是增強自身的力量。但對我來說，派遣冒險者似乎更容易。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
So, kill ^0000ff1 Dragon Tail^000000 and bring me ^0000ff1 Dragon Fly Wing^000000.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
所以，去殺^0000ff1刺尾蜻蜓^000000，並給我帶^0000ff1蜻蜓的翅膀^000000來。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
If you run out of the provided items, we cannot support more so take care.
Consider this as an extension of the survival power test.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
如果你提供的物品用完了，我們就無法再支援你了，所以請小心。
把這當作生存能力測試的延伸吧。

scripts.text: Oh, just eat up
scripts.translation: 哦，那就吃吧

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Why aren't you eating?
It's quite edible.
If you cover it with rice, it's like roasted seaweed, very tasty and delicious.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
你怎麼不吃？
這東西挺好吃的。
如果配上米飯，就像烤海苔一樣，非常美味。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
You need to be strong enough not to be so picky with such things...
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
你需要足夠強壯，才不會在這些事情上這麼挑剔...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
No thanks... anyway...

[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Hmm? Oh my, oh my, I've shown you my sloppiness.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
嗯？哎呀，哎呀，我讓你看到我的邋遢樣子了。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Ok, I'll send you to the practical test field.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
好了，我會把你送到實操測試場地。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
The practical test consists of 3 parts in total.
It's to recheck the things you've learned as a hunter or a sniper, so there's nothing much to be worried.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
實操測試總共分為3個部分。
這是為了重新檢查你作為獵人或神射手所學到的東西，所以沒什麼好擔心的。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
If you get a passing mark over three tests, you'll be on your way to becoming a Ranger.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
如果你在三次測試中都獲得及格分數，你就將踏上成為遊俠的道路。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
I'll explain the paths for the test.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
我來解釋一下測試的路徑。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Once you get into the test field, a staff will be waiting for you. Go into the room made by the staff, and standby.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
進入測試場地後，會有職員在那裡等你。
請進入職員指定的房間，然後待命。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
The test is done one by one so, if there's many people, you might need to wait.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
測試是逐個進行的，如果人多，你可能需要等待。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
The first test is to test of how keen your eyes are.
Different monsters will appear in 8 places. Kill only the monster named 'Poring' and you get a point, when you reach a certain mark, then you pass. Easy, huh?
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
第一項測試是檢驗你的眼力。
8個地點會出現不同的魔物，只擊殺名為“波利”的魔物即可得分，達到一定分數即可通過。很簡單吧？

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
The second test is about how much you can use a trap efficiently.
Get rid of monsters and do the mission by using only the provided traps, and you pass. Just be careful not to be engulfed by the explosion.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
第二項測試是檢驗你使用陷阱的效率。
僅使用提供的陷阱清除魔物並完成委託即可通過。不過要小心，別被爆炸吞沒了。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
For the 3rd test, when you become a Ranger you can handle a wolf, so you will be tested on how well you can handle such an animal.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
第三項測試，既然成為遊俠後需要馴服狼，所以會測試你駕馭這種動物的能力。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
When you remove a bomb by using the given wolf, you get points. You pass when you get a certain mark on the test.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
使用提供的狼拆除炸彈即可得分。在測試中達到一定分數即可通過。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
The staff there will tell you more details as well.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
那裡的職員也會告訴你更多細節。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Now, I will enter you into the practical test field, is your preparation all done?
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
現在，我將把你送入實操測試場地，你的準備都做好了嗎？

scripts.text: Please wait a little
scripts.translation: 請稍等

scripts.text: Let's go to the practical test field!
scripts.translation: 去實操測試場地！

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Um? Aren't you ready?
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
嗯？你還沒準備好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Well. To be careful is good.
Come back when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
好吧。謹慎是好事。
等你準備好了再來。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Um? What happened?
Why are you walking about here? What about the test?
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
嗯？發生什麼事了？
你在這裡走來走去做什麼？測試呢？

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Aha... You've failed the middle!
You are such a fool.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
啊哈...你中間那項沒通過！
你真是個笨蛋。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
So what are you going to do? Try again?
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
那你打算怎麼辦？再試一次嗎？

scripts.text: Wait a minute
scripts.translation: 等一下

scripts.text: Go to the practical test field!
scripts.translation: 去實操測試場地！

scripts.text: I give up the job change.
scripts.translation: 我放棄轉職了

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Um? Aren't you ready yet?
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
嗯？你還沒準備好嗎？

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
All right. To be careful is good.
Come when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
好吧。謹慎是好事。
等你準備好了再來。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Um? What, you're kidding huh?
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
嗯？你在開玩笑吧？

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Think again.
Do you really want to give up the job change to become a Ranger?
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
再想想。
你真的要放棄轉職為遊俠嗎？

scripts.text: No, I'll try again
scripts.translation: 不，我再試試

scripts.text: I give up!
scripts.translation: 我放棄了！

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Hey. You were kidding after all?
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
嘿。原來你是在開玩笑啊？

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
It's not funny so don't do that kind of joke again.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
這不好笑，別再開這種玩笑了。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
You don't have as many guts as I thought.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
你的膽量沒我想像的那麼大啊。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Okay. I'll respect your opinion.
I'll cancel the job change request from {0}.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
好吧。我尊重你的意見。
我會取消來自{0}的轉職申請。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Huh? Where's the bow that I gave you for the practical tests?
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
咦？我發給你的用於實操測試的弓去哪了？

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
If you don't return it, I can't cancel you job change request.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
如果不還給我，我就無法取消你的轉職申請。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Because you've disappeared suddenly, the Ranger Master was looking for you.
Do you want to go to him now?
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
因為你突然消失了，遊俠師父一直在找你。
你現在要去見他嗎？

scripts.text: Don't go
scripts.translation: 不去

scripts.text: Go
scripts.translation: 去

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Are you busy with something else?
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
你有其他事情要忙嗎？

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Then I'll send you, please be well.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
那就去吧，祝你一切順利。

scripts.text: Wow. Who's this?
scripts.translation: 哇。這是誰？

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
It seems that your dull eyes became somewhat keen now?
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
看來你那遲鈍的眼睛現在變得有點敏銳了？

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Then, enjoy an adventure well as a Ranger.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
那麼，作為遊俠好好享受冒險吧。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor]
Huh? What are you? Where are you from?
Don't hang around here doing nothing. This is my area!
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員]
咦？你是什麼人？從哪裡來的？
別在這裡閒逛。這是我的地盤！

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Stop!
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
站住！

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Where do you think you're going with that mercenary?!
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
你想帶著那個傭兵去哪？！

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
If you don't cancel the mercenary, you cannot get into the test field! Cancel it first!
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
如果不解除傭兵，你就不能進入測試場地！先解除它！

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
What, what is this?
You shouldn't keep this around!
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
這...這是什麼？
你不應該帶著這個！

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
What, what is this, a Bombring Capsule.
You shouldn't keep such a dangerous thing!
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
這...這是什麼，炸彈波利膠囊。
你不應該帶著這麼危險的東西！

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
What, what are all these Documents?
I think I know. You were going to send this to Caution, right?
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
這...這些都是什麼檔案？
我想我知道了。你是想把這個交給卡修特，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
If you hold such thing it would disturb your practical test so I'll take this.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
持有這種東西會干擾你的實操考試，所以我把它收走了。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Well, then let's gooooooooo.... oo,um?
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
那麼，我們出發吧... 呃，等等？

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Hey, what are you hiding there?
I've pointed it out for several times, you should not even think to go in there secretly with anything other than the provided items!
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
嘿，你在那裡藏什麼？
我已經提醒過你好幾次了，除了提供的物品，你甚至不該想著偷偷帶任何東西進去！

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
You'd better lighten your weight.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
你最好減輕一下負重。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
See, for the last time, I warn you that cheating is strictly banned.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
聽好了，最後一次警告你，嚴禁作弊。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Okay, once again I'll provide you with arrows, then I'll let you in.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
好的，我再給你提供一次箭矢，然後讓你進去。

scripts.text:
[Test Instructor, Teardrop]
Good luck.
Become a Ranger and we shall meet again.
scripts.translation:
[考試指導員 淚滴]
祝你好運。
成為遊俠後，我們還會再見的。

scripts.text:
[Staff DTS]
Please wait at the practical test waiting room to start the test process.
scripts.translation:
[職員 DTS]
請在實操考試候考室等待，以開始考試流程。

scripts.text:
[Staff DTS]
In the order you enter, you can take the practical test one by one.
There's 3 kinds of a Ranger job change practical tests, it takes a total of about 10 minutes.
scripts.translation:
[職員 DTS]
按照進入的順序，你們將依次進行實操考試。
遊俠轉職實操考試共有3種，總共大約需要10分鐘。

scripts.text:
[Staff DTS]
Don't you need any explanation?
scripts.translation:
[職員 DTS]
你不需要任何說明嗎？

scripts.text:
[Staff DTS]
Enter into the chat room and wait for the order and take the job change practical test.
scripts.translation:

進入聊天室，等待指令並進行轉職實操考試。

如果你想繼續實操考試，請進入聊天室。

[Staff DTS]
You don't have as many guts as I thought.
scripts.translation:
[職員 DTS]
你的膽量沒有我想像的那麼大。

scripts.translation:

scripts.translation:
[職員 DTS]

scripts.translation:

如果不還給我，我就無法取消你的轉職申請。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[職員 DTS]
我來介紹一下游俠轉職的實操考試。
在第一、第二和第三項實操考試中，你對哪一項的考試方式比較好奇？

[Staff DTS]
For the 1st test, we test your eyesight and accuracy.
scripts.translation:
[職員 DTS]
第一項考試主要測試你的視力和精準度。

scripts.text:

scripts.translation:
[職員 DTS]
魔物會隨機從玩家的上下左右八個方向出現，如果你消滅了名為“波利”的魔物，就能獲得分數。

scripts.text:
[Staff DTS]
^0000ffWhatever the form looks like, you need to kill the monster named 'Poring' to get a point, and if you get rid of others your points get deducted, so be careful.^000000
scripts.translation:
[職員 DTS]
^0000ff無論魔物呈現什麼形態，你都需要消滅名為“波利”的魔物才能得分，如果消滅了其他魔物，分數會被扣除，所以請小心。^000000

scripts.text:
[Staff DTS]
The 1st test progressing time will be about 3 minutes. When you get 15 points or more over 20, you are sent to 2nd test field.
scripts.translation:
[職員 DTS]
第一項考試的持續時間約為3分鐘。如果你在20分中獲得了15分或以上，就會被傳送到第二項考試場地。

scripts.text:
[Staff DTS]
The 2nd test is to test the mission performance ability and the efficient use of a trap.
scripts.translation:
[職員 DTS]
第二項考試主要測試任務執行能力以及陷阱的高效使用。

scripts.text:
[Staff DTS]
The attendant receives 10 'Bombring Capsules'. When you consume the Bombring Capsule, a Bombring is summoned near and after the summoning when you reach a certain time, the Bombring explodes.
scripts.translation:
[職員 DTS]
侍從會收到10個“炸彈波利膠囊”。當你使用炸彈波利膠囊時，會在附近召喚出炸彈波利，召喚後經過一定時間，炸彈波利會爆炸。

scripts.text:
[Staff DTS]
^0000ffThe Bombring explosion affects you, so be careful not to get involved in the explosion. You need to get rid of the monster by using the Bombring Capsule, accomplish the mission and come out alive.^000000
scripts.translation:
[職員 DTS]
^0000ff炸彈波利的爆炸會波及到你，所以請小心不要被捲入爆炸中。你需要使用炸彈波利膠囊消滅魔物，完成任務並活著離開。^000000

scripts.text:
[Staff DTS]
The 2nd test progressing time will be about 3 minutes. When you consume all the Bombring Capsules, collect hidden equipment, and survive, you will be sent to the 3rd test field.
scripts.translation:
[職員 DTS]
第二項考試的持續時間約為3分鐘。當你用完所有炸彈波利膠囊，收集隱藏裝備並存活下來，就會被傳送到第三項考試場地。

scripts.text:
[Staff DTS]
The 3rd is to test how you can efficiently use a wolf which is given Rangers.
scripts.translation:
[職員 DTS]
第三項考試主要測試你如何高效地使用遊俠所獲得的狼。

scripts.text:
[Staff DTS]
The tester is provided with disposable wolf summoning flute. Remove all bombs that are dispersed here and there by controlling the summoned warg and you get a point.
scripts.translation:
[職員 DTS]
考生會獲得一次性狼召喚笛。通過控制召喚出的戰狼，清除散佈在各地的炸彈，即可獲得分數。

scripts.text:
[Staff DTS]
^0000ffThe tester cannot move while the test is going on and the test is completed when he or she removes the bombs quickly and accurately in time by using only the warg.^000000
scripts.translation:
[職員 DTS]
^0000ff考試期間考生無法移動，且必須僅使用戰狼在限定時間內快速、準確地清除炸彈，考試才算完成。^000000

scripts.text:
[Staff DTS]
The 3rd test progressing time would be about 3 minutes, when you get 10 or more over 20, all the practical tests are completed.
scripts.translation:
[職員 DTS]
第三項考試的持續時間約為3分鐘，如果你在20分中獲得了10分或以上，所有實操考試即告完成。

scripts.text:
[Staff DTS]
When you want to progress with the practical test, please enter into the chat room.
scripts.translation:
[職員 DTS]
如果你想繼續實操考試，請進入聊天室。

scripts.text:
[Staff Rust]
I'll give you the 'Bombring Capsules.
The 'Bombring Capsules' can be given again only for the one who used it all, so please keep that in mind.
scripts.translation:
[職員 拉斯特]
我會給你“炸彈波利膠囊”。
只有用完所有膠囊的人才能再次領取，請記好這一點。

scripts.text:
[Staff Rust]
And the mission is.... to deliver these documents to the supervisor, Caution. He won't take what I give...
scripts.translation:
[職員 拉斯特]
任務內容是...把這些檔案交給主管 警戒。但他不會接受我送的東西...

scripts.text:
[Staff Rust]
I'm sorry, but you already have the 'Bombring Capsules', so I cannot provide you with more.
scripts.translation:
[職員 拉斯特]
很抱歉，您已經持有“炸彈波利膠囊”，所以我無法再提供給您。

scripts.text:
[Staff Rust]
Excuse me, but how did you get in?
scripts.translation:
[職員 拉斯特]
請問，您是怎麼進來的？

scripts.text:
[Staff Rust]
If you are not here for the job change test, please leave.
scripts.translation:
[職員 拉斯特]
如果您不是來參加轉職考試的，請離開。

scripts.text:
[Test Supervisor, Caution]
Come, come near, nearer, nearer!!
scripts.translation:
[考試監督 警戒]
過來，過來，再靠近一點！！

scripts.text:
[Test Supervisor, Caution]
No, no!
You need to use all the 'Bombring Capsules'?!
scripts.translation:
[考試監督 警戒]
不，不！
你需要用完所有的“炸彈波利膠囊”嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Test Supervisor, Caution]
Use it all and come back!
Time is ticking so you'd better hurry.
scripts.translation:
[考試監督 警戒]
全部用完再回來！
時間緊迫，你最好快點。

scripts.text:
[Test Supervisor, Caution]
You've arrived safely!!!
scripts.translation:
[考試監督 警戒]
你安全到達了！！！

scripts.text:
[Test Supervisor, Caution]
What are those documents?
scripts.translation:
[考試監督 警戒]
那些檔案是什麼？

scripts.text: Mr. Rust asked me to give this to you.
scripts.translation: 拉斯特先生讓我把這個交給您。

scripts.text:
[Test Supervisor, Caution]
Haaaaaaaah!!
I've been avoiding him so much!!
scripts.translation:
[考試監督 警戒]
哈啊啊啊啊！！
我一直都在躲著他！！

scripts.text:
[Test Supervisor, Caution]
I've never imagined this could be a test...
scripts.translation:
[考試監督 警戒]
我從未想過這竟然是一場考試...

scripts.text:
[Test Supervisor, Caution]
Anyway you've passed the 2nd test very well.
scripts.translation:
[考試監督 警戒]
總之，你非常順利地通過了第二項考試。

scripts.text:
[Test Supervisor, Caution]
Pass the 3rd one and you will become a great ranger.
scripts.translation:
[考試監督 警戒]
通過第三項考試，你就會成為一名優秀的遊俠。

scripts.text:
[Test Supervisor, Caution]
You've arrived safely......uh?
scripts.translation:
[考試監督 警戒]
你安全到達了......呃？

scripts.text:
[Test Supervisor, Caution]
Didn't Rust give you something?
scripts.translation:
[考試監督 警戒]
拉斯特沒給你什麼東西嗎？

scripts.text:
[Test Supervisor, Caution]
Where did you lose that?
Pick it up quickly!
scripts.translation:
[考試監督 警戒]
你把它弄丟在哪裡了？
快撿起來！

scripts.text:
[Test Supervisor, Freeze]
Congrats for passing the 2nd practical test! I am the 3rd practical test supervisor Freeze!
scripts.translation:
[考試監督 冰凍]
恭喜通過第二項實操考試！我是第三項實操考試的監督 冰凍！

scripts.text:
[Test Supervisor, Freeze]
Good! Then I'll start the test right now!
scripts.translation:
[考試監督 冰凍]
很好！那麼我現在就開始考試！

scripts.text:
[Test Supervisor, Freeze]
Huh?! There's no wolf, no Test Flute, where did you get rid of them?!
scripts.translation:
[考試監督 冰凍]
什麼？！沒有狼，也沒有測試笛，你把它們弄到哪裡去了？！

scripts.text:
[Test Supervisor, Freeze]
Ha? What are you doing?
scripts.translation:
[考試監督 冰凍]
哈？你在幹什麼？

scripts.text:
[Test Supervisor, Freeze]
Who are you?
scripts.translation:
[考試監督 冰凍]
你是誰？

scripts.text:
[Test Supervisor, Freeze]
For the 3rd test, I'll test how much you could use a wolf effectively. When you become a Ranger in the future, you'll learn an wolf!
scripts.translation:
[考試監督 冰凍]
第三項考試將測試你使用狼的能力。將來你成為遊俠後，就會學會馴養狼！

scripts.text:
[Test Supervisor, Freeze]
^0000ffThe tester is provided with a disposable Wolf summoning Flute! When you remove egg bombs coming out from here and there by controlling the summoned wolf, you get points!^000000
scripts.translation:
[考試監督 冰凍]
^0000ff考生將獲得一支一次性狼召喚笛！通過控制召喚出的狼，消除這裡那裡冒出的蛋炸彈即可獲得分數！^000000

scripts.text:
[Test Supervisor, Freeze]
Tester cannot move during the test, and the test completes when all bombs are removed quickly and accurately within the given time only by using a wolf!
scripts.translation:
[考試監督 冰凍]
考試期間考生不得移動，且必須在限定時間內，僅使用狼快速且準確地消除所有炸彈，考試才算完成！

scripts.text:
[Test Supervisor, Freeze]
^0000ffThe way to control an wolf is to press the alt key and left-click the surface, then the wolf moves to the point where you've clicked on!^000000
^0000ffWhen you target the bomb and press one more, it starts to attack!^000000
scripts.translation:
[考試監督 冰凍]
^0000ff控制狼的方法是按住Alt鍵並左鍵點選地面，狼就會移動到你點選的位置！^000000
^0000ff當你鎖定炸彈並再次按下時，它就開始攻擊！^000000

scripts.text:
[Test Supervisor, Freeze]
The 3rd test time limit is about 3 minutes, when you get 10 over 20 points, you can pass the practical test!
scripts.translation:
[考試監督 冰凍]
第三項考試的時間限制約為3分鐘，只要獲得20分中的10分以上，即可通過實操考試！

scripts.text:
[Test Supervisor, Freeze]
Well, then first get this Wolf' flutes and after summoning the wolf, talk to me!
scripts.translation:
[考試監督 冰凍]
那麼，先拿好這支狼笛，召喚出狼後再來找我！

scripts.text:
[Test Supervisor, Freeze]
Keep in mind! You need to remove the egg bomb before it gets exploded by only using a wolf!
scripts.translation:
[考試監督 冰凍]
記住！在炸彈爆炸之前，你必須僅使用狼將其消除！

scripts.text:
[Test Supervisor, Freeze]
Then, good luck!
scripts.translation:
[考試監督 冰凍]
那麼，祝你好運！

scripts.text:
[Test Supervisor, Freeze]
I'll give you one more time specially, so hold yourself together!
scripts.translation:
[考試監督 冰凍]
我特別再給你一次機會，所以請振作起來！

scripts.text:
[Test Supervisor, Freeze]
Summon the wolf quickly, and talk to me again!
scripts.translation:
[考試監督 冰凍]
快召喚狼，然後再來找我！

scripts.text:
[Test Supervisor, Freeze]
Play the Test Flute quickly to summon the wolf and talk to me!
scripts.translation:
[考試監督 冰凍]
快吹響測試笛召喚狼，然後來找我！

scripts.text:
[Test Supervisor, Freeze]
This area is for the Ranger Job Change test!
You are not authorized to be here, please get out!
scripts.translation:
[考試監督 冰凍]
這裡是遊俠轉職考試區域！
你沒有許可權待在這裡，請離開！

scripts.text:
[Ranger Master, Neveragain]
... ...Huh?
It's weird... How did you get here?
scripts.translation:
[遊俠大師 永不再]
... ...嗯？
真奇怪... 你是怎麼來到這裡的？

scripts.text:
[Ranger Master, Neveragain]
No.
I can tell just by looking at you that you seem to be inexperienced.
scripts.translation:
[遊俠大師 永不再]
不。
光看你的樣子，我就知道你是個新手。

scripts.text:
[Ranger Master, Neveragain]
Congratulations!
You've completed all the rough practical tests!
scripts.translation:
[遊俠大師 永不再]
恭喜！
你已完成所有初步實操考試！

scripts.text:
[Ranger Master, Neveragain]
Hey, you look great.
What are you doing here?
scripts.translation:
[遊俠大師 永不再]
嘿，你看起來不錯。
你在這裡做什麼？

scripts.text:
[Ranger Master, Neveragain]
You don't seem to belong here...
scripts.translation:
[遊俠大師 永不再]
你似乎不屬於這裡...

scripts.text:
[Ranger Master, Neveragain]
Go away.
You are not supposed to be here.
scripts.translation:
[遊俠大師 永不再]
離開。
你不應該在這裡。

scripts.text:
[Ranger Master, Neveragain]
Have more pride in your job and get more experience, and then when you grow as a Hunter or a Sniper you can make an aura by yourself, please come back again.
scripts.translation:
[遊俠大師 永不再]
請對自己的職業更有自豪感，多積累經驗。等你成長為獵人或神射手後，就能自己製造靈氣了。請再來找我。

scripts.text:
[Ranger Master, Neveragain]
Well, you've had enough experience so I won't need to drag on.
scripts.translation:
[遊俠大師 永不再]
既然你已經積累了足夠的經驗，我就不囉嗦了。

scripts.text:
[Ranger Master, Neveragain]
Before you do a job change ^0000ffdismiss your Falcon^000000, and check if you've used all of your ^0000ffSkill Points^000000.
scripts.translation:
[遊俠大師 永不再]
在轉職之前，^0000ff收回你的獵鷹^000000，並確認是否已經用完了所有的^0000ff技能點^000000。

scripts.text: Wait a minute
scripts.translation: 等一下

scripts.text: I am ready
scripts.translation: 我準備好了

scripts.text:
[Ranger Master, Neveragain]
I am not running away so take your time.
scripts.translation:
[遊俠大師 永不再]
我沒有要逃跑，你慢慢來。

scripts.text:
[Ranger Master, Neveragain]
Didn't you dismiss your falcon??
scripts.translation:
[遊俠大師 永不再]
你沒有收回獵鷹嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ranger Master, Neveragain]
I think you need to learn more.
scripts.translation:
[遊俠大師 永不再]
我覺得你還需要多學習一下。

scripts.text:
[Ranger Master, Neveragain]
Good. No falcon and you've used up all your skill points.
scripts.translation:
[遊俠大師 永不再]
很好。沒有獵鷹，而且技能點也用完了。

scripts.text:
[Ranger Master, Neveragain]
Please dismiss your falcon, and come back to me.
scripts.translation:
[遊俠大師 永不再]
請收回你的獵鷹，然後回來找我。

scripts.text:
[Ranger Master Neveragain]
Use up all of your skill points before continuing on.
scripts.translation:
[遊俠大師 永不再]
在繼續之前，請用完所有的技能點。

scripts.text:
[Ranger Master, Neveragain]
Okay, before you really change the job into a ranger, I'll ask you on more time.
Do you really want to become a ranger?
scripts.translation:
[遊俠大師 永不再]
好吧，在你真正轉職為遊俠之前，我要再問你一次。
你真的想成為遊俠嗎？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 否

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 準備好了！

scripts.text:
[Ranger Master, Neveragain]
...Um? That's not the answer that I was waiting for...
scripts.translation:
[遊俠大師 永不再]
...嗯？這不是我期待的答案...

scripts.text:
[Ranger Master, Neveragain]
Even after passing through all the rough practical tests, you don't want to become a ranger... are you sure?
scripts.translation:
[遊俠大師 永不再]
即使通過了所有艱難的實操考試，你也不想像成為遊俠...你確定嗎？

scripts.text:
[Ranger Master, Neveragain]
You are on a riding pet,
so you cannot change your job.
Please unequip your riding pet and try again!
scripts.translation:
[遊俠大師 永不再]
你正騎著坐騎，
所以無法轉職。
請卸下坐騎後再試一次！

scripts.text:
[Ranger Master, Neveragain]
Wait, who are you?
You are not a Hunter or a Sniper?!
scripts.translation:
[遊俠大師 永不再]
等等，你是誰？
你不是獵人或神射手嗎？！

scripts.text:
[Ranger Master, Neveragain]
Your firm answer seems very trustworthy!
scripts.translation:
[遊俠大師 永不再]
你堅定的回答聽起來很可信！

scripts.text:
[Ranger Master, Neveragain]
What are you doing here?
You are not supposed to be here. Get out!
scripts.translation:
[遊俠大師 永不再]
你在這裡做什麼？
你不應該在這裡。快滾！

scripts.text:
[Ranger Master, Neveragain]
Umm?
You need to return the borrowed stuff.
Where is the bow that was given to you for the job change test?
scripts.translation:
[遊俠大師 永不再]
嗯？
你需要歸還借用的物品。
用於轉職測試的那把弓在哪裡？

scripts.text:
[Ranger Master, Neveragain]
From now on be active as a splendid Ranger!
I wish you luck in your future!
scripts.translation:
[遊俠大師 永不再]
從現在開始，作為出色的遊俠積極活動吧！
祝你未來好運！

scripts.text: I just came by
scripts.translation: 我只是路過

scripts.text: Please let me be out
scripts.translation: 請讓我離開

scripts.text:
[Ranger Master, Neveragain]
Well, there's nothing to see and you came.
scripts.translation:
[遊俠大師 永不再]
既然來了，也沒什麼好看的。

scripts.text:
[Ranger Master, Neveragain]
Take a rest as long as you want.
It's the place where you can have a tea easily.
scripts.translation:
[遊俠大師 永不再]
想休息多久就休息多久吧。
這裡是能輕鬆喝杯茶的地方。

scripts.text:
[Ranger Master, Neveragain]
It was good to see you.
Don't lose the dignity as a Ranger wherever you go.
scripts.translation:
[遊俠大師 永不再]
很高興見到你。
無論去往何處，都不要失去遊俠的尊嚴。

scripts.translation: 停用候診室

scripts.translation: 啟用第一關測試

scripts.translation: 停用第一關測試

scripts.translation: 停用第二關測試

scripts.translation: 停用第三關測試

scripts.translation: 已啟用第一關測試

scripts.translation: 已停用第一關測試

scripts.translation: 已停用第二關測試

scripts.translation: 已停用第三關測試
